title: Horizontal proper/open transport pasting
statement: For Operations o, Compositors c, OpenComparisons a, a supplied proper/open gamma and a section-normalized canonical bridge b [def-sf-integral-system-operations, def-sf-integral-system-realization-data, def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], assume gamma satisfies the canonical component equation identifying it with the intrinsic semilinear gamma. Then the horizontal field of ProperOpenTransportPasting holds, with exactly the compositors and all the schemes, morphisms, properness and quasi-compact-open hypotheses of the displayed Lean statement.

source.place: Pasting equations for transported proper/open gamma

proof.text: Package the intrinsic seven edge functors, both composite open functors, the two open compositors and the three canonical mates as nativeHorizontalData. Its horizontal field is exactly the horizontal conjunct of semilinearProperOpenMatePasting. Specialize this real construction to scalarRings and scalarTransitions.
Package the nine bridge isomorphisms. The binary open-compositor bridge theorem supplies the two row equations; the supplied canonical gamma equation supplies the three square equations.

Eliminate the constructed witness so its functors remain abstract, then apply horizontalMateTransport. That theorem cancels the invertible endpoint and source compositor, uses naturality and the five comparison equations, and reduces to intrinsic horizontal pasting.

proof_origin.place: Coefficient comparisons preserve tensor reassociation, evaluation and adjunction units and counits; the binary open-composition case, expanded in the proof of lem-sf-integral-system-proper-open-transport.

lean.statement:
theorem integralSystemProperOpenTransportPastingHorizontal
(o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    (_a : OpenComparisons l E o c)
    (gamma : ∀ {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W)
      (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
      [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p]
      (_h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i),
      Operations.push l E o r ⋙ Operations.shriek l E o i ⟶
        Operations.shriek l E o k ⋙ Operations.push l E o p)
    (b : CanonicalBridge l E o)
    (hgamma : ∀ {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W)
      (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
      [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p]
      (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : System l E U),
      (gamma k r p i h).app M ≫ (b.push l E p).hom.app ((Operations.shriek l E o k).obj M) ≫
        (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.R (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) p).map
          ((b.shriek l E k).hom.app M) =
      (b.shriek l E i).hom.app ((Operations.push l E o r).obj M) ≫
        (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.J (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) i).map
          ((b.push l E r).hom.app M) ≫
        (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.gamma (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E)
          k r p i h).app M) :
  ∀ {A C E₀ B₀ D F : Scheme.{u}}
      (k : A ⟶ B₀) (ll : B₀ ⟶ E₀) (i : C ⟶ D) (j : D ⟶ F)
      (r : A ⟶ C) (p : B₀ ⟶ D) (q : E₀ ⟶ F)
      [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion ll] [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j]
      [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact ll] [QuasiCompact i] [QuasiCompact j]
      [IsProper r] [IsProper p] [IsProper q]
      (h₁ : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (h₂ : ll ≫ q = p ≫ j)
      (h : (k ≫ ll) ≫ q = r ≫ (i ≫ j)) (M : System l E A),
      (c.openComp l E i j).hom.app ((Operations.push l E o r).obj M) ≫
          (gamma (k ≫ ll) r q (i ≫ j) h).app M ≫
          (Operations.push l E o q).map ((c.openComp l E k ll).inv.app M) =
        (Operations.shriek l E o j).map ((gamma k r p i h₁).app M) ≫
          (gamma ll p q j h₂).app ((Operations.shriek l E o k).obj M)

statement_change.what: STATEMENT-DISPUTED (repaired): arbitrary gamma cannot satisfy a law linear in the outer gamma and quadratic in the two inner gammas. Negating the canonical family on identity squares over nonzero coefficients of odd characteristic gives opposite signs. Require precisely the canonical bridge equation already provided by the caller, rather than asserting the law for an unrelated family. No target or definition changes.
